panel.title: 🔁 Trade-Ups
panel.text:
Want a second opinion on a trade-up? Run it through the **CSFloat Trade-Up Calculator**, take a full screenshot, then click **Post a trade-up**.

Tell the community your goal and what you need checked. Your post is titled `[Trade-Up] - Target skin - % chance to profit`.
